job.job_title: Senior Software Engineer (Backend, Cloud Network Management)
job.job_description:
Design and develop cloud-based backend services responsible for configuration, provisioning, monitoring, and lifecycle management of network switches and Wi Fi access points .
Build scalable and secure REST and gRPC APIs using Python and/or Go to enable device onboarding, policy management, telemetry ingestion, and cloud orchestration.
Implement backend workflows for device configuration management , firmware upgrades, policy rollout, and real time state synchronization between cloud and network devices.
Develop cloud native microservices ensuring high availability, scalability, fault tolerance, and performance across globally distributed deployments.
Collaborate with frontend, platform, networking, and QA teams to deliver reliable end to end cloud managed networking solutions.
Requirements :
Strong backend development experience using Python and/or Go , including designing and maintaining REST/gRPC based service architectures.
Experience building cloud native applications on AWS, Azure, or GCP using microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Hands on experience with network device management systems , including switches, Wi Fi access points, or cloud managed networking platforms.
Solid experience working with databases (SQL/NoSQL) , distributed data stores, and large scale telemetry, metrics, and event processing systems.
Working knowledge of networking and security fundamentals , including certificates, encryption, authentication, and firewall/UTM concepts.
Additional Skills (Nice to Have)
Frontend development experience using Vue.js , with familiarity in React or React Native .
Strong proficiency in JavaScript / TypeScript .
Exposure to Wi Fi Network Manager systems , controller less or cloud managed architectures.
Familiarity with Wi Fi planning tools , visualization frameworks, or Java + JSP based UI components.
